articles.title: Robinhood Expands Prediction Markets: A New Revenue Stream Ahead?
articles.summary: Robinhood is launching prediction markets, adding yet another betting product to its retail trading arsenal. If they can convert their 23M users even partially, this becomes the most consequential distribution play for prediction markets since the category's inception.

articles.title: It’s up to Congress to clean up the country’s prediction-market mess
articles.summary: Congress is finally acknowledging that prediction markets need actual rules instead of the legal gray zone they've been operating in. If they actually legislate this space, we're either getting a legitimacy boost that transforms these markets into real price-discovery engines, or we're getting regulations so restrictive that half the interesting bets disappear.

articles.title: How Louisiana became a battleground in the national fight over prediction markets
articles.summary: Louisiana's regulatory crackdown on prediction markets is forcing the industry to fight on unfamiliar legal ground, turning a single state into a test case for broader restrictions. If Louisiana succeeds in boxing out the platforms, it'll give other states a roadmap to follow, and suddenly your favorite markets could vanish overnight.

articles.title: In defense of prediction markets
articles.summary: Prediction markets are catching heat from critics, and someone's finally making the case that they're actually useful tools for forecasting reality. If this defense sticks, it could shift how regulators and the public view these markets as legitimate information aggregators instead of glorified gambling dens.

articles.title: 'Survival is at stake': Inside prediction markets' race to curb inside trading - ABC News
articles.source: Breaking News, Latest News and Videos
articles.summary: Regulators and market operators are cracking down on insider trading in prediction markets, where people with non-public information can easily profit before major announcements. If they don't fix this, the whole industry tanks, because no one's betting real money on markets they know are rigged.

articles.title: Opinion | Kalshi’s sports bets are everywhere. They’re also likely illegal.
articles.summary: Kalshi, a CFTC-regulated prediction market platform, is reportedly offering sports betting products that may violate federal and state gambling laws. If regulators crack down, it could signal that the line between legal prediction markets and illegal sports gambling isn't where the industry thought it was.

articles.title: LA Lakers announce deal with Kalshi, signaling sports leagues’ growing embrace of prediction markets
articles.summary: The LA Lakers just inked a deal with Kalshi, the CFTC-regulated prediction market platform, marking the first major U.S. sports league partnership with a legal prediction market operator. This blows open the mainstream credibility door for prediction markets, suggesting the regulatory and cultural gatekeepers are finally accepting that these platforms aren't just crypto gambling dens.

articles.title: Prediction markets push OpenAI IPO expectations later into 2027
articles.summary: OpenAI's path to going public just got pushed further down the calendar, with prediction markets now pricing the IPO for late 2027 instead of earlier in the year. That matters because it extends the runway for every bettor holding positions on the timing, and it signals the market thinks the company needs more time to prove its AI moat is defensible at IPO valuations.

articles.title: Danny McBride Stars in Another Kalshi Ad as Annoying Uncle at Thanksgiving (EXCLUSIVE)
articles.summary: Kalshi grabbed another celebrity endorsement by casting Danny McBride as the obnoxious uncle spouting unsolicited opinions at the Thanksgiving table, presumably to sell their prediction market platform as the antidote to family arguments about what's actually going to happen. The repeated star power plays signal Kalshi's doubling down on mainstream consumer acquisition right when prediction market adoption is hitting an inflection point, which matters because brand spending correlates hard with user growth expectations that traders are already pricing into regulated futures platforms.

articles.title: Kalshi NFL Market for Every Thanksgiving Game: Bills vs. Chiefs Should Be Tight
articles.summary: Kalshi just launched prediction markets for every Thanksgiving NFL game, giving bettors granular odds on what's traditionally one of the year's most-watched sports days. Bills-Chiefs being tagged as tight means smart money's split on a matchup everyone and their uncle will be betting, which creates juice opportunities for people willing to dig into team-specific metrics.

articles.title: Utah moves to drop criminal charges after Kalshi blocks Utah users
articles.summary: Utah's attorney general backed off criminal charges against prediction market platform Kalshi after a court blocked the state from barring its residents from trading on political and economic contracts. The reversal signals that crypto-adjacent betting platforms are starting to win legal battles against state regulators, which could accelerate the normalization of prediction markets as legitimate financial instruments.

articles.title: Utah scores win against Kalshi as company halts operations in state
articles.summary: Utah just blocked Kalshi from operating in the state, forcing the prediction market platform to pull out. This is a test case for whether states can unilaterally shut down federally-approved prediction markets, and the answer matters a lot for anyone betting on elections or events.
